title: Merge Intervals
description: Merge all overlapping intervals into a sorted list of disjoint ranges.

data.text: Given an array of intervals `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [start, end]`, merge all overlapping intervals and return a new array of non-overlapping intervals.
Sort by start, then merge while iterating. O(n log n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Sort + Merge O(n log n)

data.text: Reuse the input array as the output list, writing merged intervals from the front. O(n log n) time, O(1) extra space (ignoring sort).

data.title: In-Place O(n log n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n log n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1) extra. Sorting is unavoidable — overlapping intervals can be in any order. The in-place variant just trims the output array.

cards.title: In-Place
cards.description: Write merged intervals back into the input
